difficulty_reason: Prove valuative existence for Quot_F/X/B over a proper fp base: reduce to extending a coherent generic-fibre quotient F_K -> Q_K over a valuation ring R; solve affine-locally by the kernel submodule L = {x in M | phi(x tensor 1) = 0}: M/L is R-torsion-free hence flat (valuation-ring torsion-free-flat lemma), finitely presented as an A-module, and the unique quotient with generic fibre N_K; glue the affine-local solutions over a surjective etale cover U -> X using separatedness of X (U x_X U affine) and uniqueness of the construction, descending the quotient F|_U -> Q_U to F -> Q via the quasi-coherent descent proposition.
